data.why: The dashboard is pure client-side HTML/JS with no backend; every workflow (raw rainfall, IDF table, SCS CN, Rational Method) ships with built-in sample/demo buttons (e.g. loadSample(), loadRawRainSample(), loadDesignTableSample()) and the IDF table textarea is pre-filled, so no external files need to be copied or synthesized.

goals: Set up project identity (name, designer, design code/reference) for a preliminary stormwater design
Prepare raw rainfall data (paste, upload CSV, or load the built-in sample) and extract an Annual Maximum Series
Build or adopt an IDF (intensity-duration-frequency) table/curve and read off a design intensity I at a chosen time of concentration and return period
Compute SCS Curve Number runoff depth from rainfall depth, CN, AMC condition, and initial abstraction ratio
Generate a design storm hyetograph with the Rainfall Designer and review its cumulative/incremental distribution
Compute Rational Method peak discharge (Q = C x I x A / 360) and export the results dashboard as CSV/PNG or a printed report

review.summary: This is a thorough, well-evidenced tree that follows the README's stated workflow, from project setup through raw rainfall → Gumbel IDF → design intensity → SCS-CN / design storm / Rational Method → results, and its features are cut at a reusable grain. It needs small corrections before filing: the goal overstates the tool as 'sizing' a drain, t12's interpolation claim has no screen showing a result, the Huff observation is a code bug rather than a data issue, and the unreachable report/print code should be noted.
